summary: Stardust Power Inc. filed an 8-K to report entry into an At Market Issuance Sales Agreement with B. Riley Securities as agent. The agreement allows the company to sell up to $5 million of its common stock in at-the-market offerings through ordinary brokers' transactions on Nasdaq. Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. The agent receives customary commissions and indemnification. No premium, stake, or special-situation deal terms. This is a routine equity shelf takedown arrangement, not a change-of-control, restructuring, or other special situation.
